items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Charlie Elgin; the mention occurs in the interviewer's turn ('At the Svobal with Charlie Elgin').

ctx.x: Yeah, I played with Keppard for a while. How did you like him? At the Svobal with Charlie Elgin. Oh, he was a terrific drive, a trumpet player. He was a nice tone.
How did you compare him with Oliver, a different style in Oliver? Well he had a much, he had more drive than Oliver.
